In-wall actor teleports to original callback X,Y+1,Z. Outside the alive block, Crawling dimension Y>250 teleports original callback X,Y-2,Z even if actor no longer alive. Native ServerPlayer connection branches cannot apply to concrete Monster. Overlay, particles, sounds and visual lightning are excluded from scalar observations.

With an unwrapLookup the hook creates mutable enchantment levels,posts GetEnchantmentLevelEvent,then returns mutable.getLevel; without lookup it returns the supplied level. Repeated reads therefore are not guaranteed stable by the native API. The guarded zero-requery request is conditional native code,not proven dead or a normal base-level0 profile.
